: '''✓ 2026-07-11 (bot):''' Done — <code>docs/deity_qualifier_analysis_2026-07.md</code>. Q137721156 (日月神社) uses a gold-standard model: each 祭神 (P825) carries P1932 "object named as" (原文表記, the source's exact spelling) + a book reference (神奈川県神社誌, page 357, NDL persistent id). But it's rare — only 80 of 21,405 Japanese P825 statements carry P1932, and 77 of those are from that same book; P143 "imported from Japanese Wikipedia" is the DOMINANT reference marker (3,339 vs 1,441 with the URL) yet our importer was missing it. Acted on it: (1) added S143=Q177837 to the deity importer + all jawiki importers where it's the corpus standard (founding-date, sango, honzon, shintai; NOT festival/kofun/hisousha, which use their own); (2) the P3831=主祭神 principal-deity role is essentially unused (Q137721156 doesn't mark which of its 4 is principal) — the generator already emits it, just needs the drip; (3) prefectural 神社誌 are ~17 NDL-viewable, so the book-citation model is extensible. Also fixed 41 malformed multi-name P1932 values in the pipeline.
